items.title: Google Awards $250,000 Bounty for Chrome RCE Vulnerability Discovery
items.description: Google has awarded a record-breaking $250,000 bounty to security researcher “Micky” for discovering a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Chrome’s browser architecture. The vulnerability allowed malicious websites to escape Chrome’s sandbox protection and execute arbitrary code on victim systems.
